_comment: MANUAL TAP of an ARTIFACT filter, the accepting side (USER 2026-10-22; docs/design/viewer-manual-tap-pay.md, 'Artifact and creature sources'). Island first, then Izzet Signet with the multi-letter face ':UR': the Island's {U} pays the Signet's {1} out of the floating pool (PayCostFromFloat, the activation-cost path), the Signet taps through the payer's own TapConversionSource and adds {U}{R}, and Tandem Lookout ({2}{U}) is paid from that float plus the second Island. Twin of niv_manual_tap_signet_unfed.json (same board, no feeder tapped -> illegal). Fails if the ':UR' face stops parsing, if the fed mode stops being offered, or if the feed stops coming from the pool.
